nonClaims: Pacti is not admitted as a packages/composition runtime dependency by this evidence.
Pacti does not give formal semantics to existing natural-language R1 gate assumptions or guarantees.
This pilot does not establish temporal-protocol verification coverage.

decisions.scope: Formalizable assume-guarantee algebra: composition, quotient, merge and refinement.
decisions.boundary: Invoke only when a seam has an explicit Pacti-representable contract. Keep packages/composition independent of Pacti until a real recurring consumer justifies dependency admission.

decisions.scope: Concurrent/state-machine safety and liveness model checking for bounded TLA+ abstractions.
decisions.boundary: Runtime already uses digest-pinned TLC for RuntimeDispatchR1. A passing model is abstraction evidence, not implementation refinement proof.

decisions.scope: Temporal-contract refinement, LTL proof obligations and asynchronous compositional verification.
decisions.boundary: Use OCRA temporal-refinement semantics as a reference. Official latest release is 2.1.0 (2021); do not admit the binary without a real gap, licensing/toolchain review, and comparative evidence against existing TLA+/TLC.

decisions.scope: Symbolic/bounded TLA+/Quint model checking when SMT/state-space pressure exceeds TLC.
decisions.boundary: Do not add Apalache until a real model demonstrates TLC scaling or symbolic-analysis pressure.
Do not replace R1 gate truth with SACM. Add a projection only when an assurance consumer needs one.

decisions.scope: Human-readable assurance argument visualization, context, assumptions and challenges/dialectics.
decisions.boundary: GSN is a presentation/argument structure, not proof or domain acceptance authority.
Do not create an Ordivon provenance ontology.

decisions.scope: Operational Job/Run/Dataset lineage and exact runtime dataflow.
decisions.boundary: Do not use OpenLineage as a semantic assurance argument graph.
Composition consumes verified attestations; it must not synthesize SLSA provenance.
Do not replace R1 gate results with a private attestation format.

coreDecision.rationale: The mature external methods are admitted as scoped owners/providers/projections around the thin composition waist, not copied into it.
